meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, FLUX, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 AI 模型生成或编辑各类图片

copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images with AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create or edit visual assets

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以根据你的文字描述生成或编辑图像，并保存为 PNG 文件。需要先配置 OpenRouter API 密钥。
howto.when: 当你要求生成照片、插图、概念艺术等非技术图表时，或者要求对已有图像进行编辑时触发。

say.note: Claude 会调用脚本生成图像并保存。

say.text: 把这张照片的背景改成蓝色
say.note: 需要提供原图路径，Claude 会进行编辑。

say.text: 用 FLUX Pro 生成一只太空猫
say.note: 可以指定模型提高质量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or edit images from your text description and save them as PNG files. Requires an OpenRouter API key to be configured.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate photos, illustrations, concept art (non-technical), or edit an existing image.

say_en.note: Claude runs the script and saves the image.

say_en.text: Change the background of this photo to blue.
say_en.note: Provide the input image path; Claude edits it.

say_en.text: Use FLUX Pro to generate a cat in space.
say_en.note: Specifying a model can improve quality.
